    # Deviation from average utilization (relative to bin capacity)
    utilization_deviation = np.abs((current_load / bins[valid_mask]) - avg_utilization) if len(current_load) > 0 else np.zeros_like(current_load)
    
    # Normalize deviation to penalty score (smaller deviation = higher priority)
    deviation_penalty = 1.0 / (1.0 + utilization_deviation + 1e-8)
    
    # Ratio of remaining capacity to item size
    ratio = remaining[valid_mask] / (item + 1e-8)
    
    # Combined score: balance between remaining space and deviation from average load
    combined_score = ratio * deviation_penalty
    
    # Apply to valid bins
    priorities[valid_mask] = combined_score
    
    return priorities
